name: whisper-large-v3-turbo-swiss-german-mit
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo (config.json max_position_embeddings 1500). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.809 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2026-09-23.

benchmarks.name: Swiss German Dialects test - WER dev %
benchmarks.config: Card table 'Model | WER dev | WER final | CER | RTF': row 'this checkpoint' 23.7% vs row 'openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo (no fine-tune)' 26.5%. FHNW/i4ds All Swiss German Dialects test set, 5750 clips, 12.7 h, 17 dialects; faster-whisper CTranslate2 float16 beam 5 on RTX 3080 Ti. Lower is better.

benchmarks.name: Swiss German Dialects test - WER final %
benchmarks.config: Same table: this 25.9% vs base 28.5%. Final half (2820 clips) is the held-out half; dev was used for model selection.

benchmarks.name: Swiss German Dialects test - CER %
benchmarks.config: Same table, CER column: this 13.4% vs base 14.6%. Lower is better.
